title: Day 110: Trump and Pezeshkian Formally Sign 14-Point Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding
detail: Trump signed the hard-copy 14-point MOU at the Palace of Versailles during a dinner with French President Macron following the G7 summit; Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian signed remotely from Tehran. Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif signed as mediator, with Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt also facilitating. Key terms: immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts including Lebanon; US to begin removing its naval blockade of Iran immediately, fully within 30 days; Iran to arrange free safe passage for commercial vessels through the Gulf for 60 days; Iran to maintain nuclear-program status quo; US to impose no new sanctions or additional regional force deployments; both sides to negotiate a final deal within 60 days.
